derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2923 (κριτής);
def: a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal

occurrences.text: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
